sentences.text: The night looked calm, but the parents' room stayed below 18.0 °C throughout the night.
The temperature was coldest at 00:00, reaching 17.3 °C.
Since the room stayed below 18.0 °C, please remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Because of the low temperature shown in the check, perhaps checking the heating might be a gentle idea.
